card.name: Linking words before a second drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, and, or without that sit between two drugs in interaction or co-use sentences. It also fires partway through drug names like niacin and cyclosporine.

modes.label: Linking word between drugs
modes.description: A word like with or and that joins one drug to another in a co-administration statement.
modes.example: Co-administration of propranolol<< and>> diltiazem in patients with cardiac

modes.label: Inside drug or medical terms
modes.description: Partway through a longer drug or medical word, where the rest of the word is still to come.
modes.example: modify the dosage of cyclo<<sp>>orine as appropriate when used concom
